subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: A city has a population density of $800$ people per square mile. Which of the following is closest to this density, in people per square kilometer? ($1$ mile $= 1.609$ kilometers)
explanation: Choice A is correct. Since $1$ mile $= 1.609$ kilometers, $1$ square mile $= 1.609^2 = 2.589$ square kilometers. To convert people per square mile to people per square kilometer, divide: $\frac{800}{2.589} \approx 309$ people per square kilometer.
